description: Scans a local directory for leaks of secrets, keys, and PII. Returns a summary report. Use this tool for Security Auditing.

directory_path.description: Absolute path to the directory to audit.

extensions.description: List of file extensions to scan (e.g. ['.env', '.log', '.js']). If empty, scans all text files.

ignore_node_modules.description: Whether to ignore 'node_modules' directories. Defaults to true.

profile.description: The detection profile to use. Defaults to 'General'.

name: audit_directory_for_pii
